_readme: HAPPY's rules for every website MARK builds. Each rule is on or off, and either block (the site fails and stays in Demo built) or warn (noted on the report, still passes). Change them here, no code needed.

file_exists.what: the website file exists and is a full page

no_broken_media.what: every photo, logo and video on the page is really there

business_name.what: their business name is on the page

phone_matches.what: the phone number on the page is the one EDITH found

no_placeholders.what: no broken text like undefined, NaN, lorem ipsum or {{ }}

reviews_are_real.what: every review on the page is one of their real reviews

demo_is_hidden.what: the demo bar is showing and Google is told not to index it

booking_link_works.what: the Book button goes to a live booking page that answers

has_logo.what: their logo is on the page

min_photos.what: at least this many of their own photos

min_services.what: at least this many services listed

some_prices.what: at least this many services show a price

short_headline.what: the headline is at most this many words

browser_check.what: opens in Chrome on a computer and a phone with no errors, nothing sticking out sideways on the phone
